Title: SAGE Project Forensic State & Handover

SAGE Project Forensic State & Handover 

Mar 30, 2026, 11:24:40 AM 
 SAGE Project Forensic State & Handover 
 SAGE Project: Forensic Pivot State
Environment Constraints:

• OS: Android / Termux

• Python: 3.13 (Strict asyncio requirements)

• Library: `websockets` v13.x (Requires `websockets.asyncio.server`)

Critical Technical Blocks:

• MediaPipe Wall: Incompatible with Termux/AARCH64. All skeleton-tracking logic must be replaced with OpenCV pixel-differencing.

• Handshake Spam: Chrome/Android sends `keep-alive` headers that crash standard websocket servers.

• The Shield: Must use a `process_request` hook in `server.py` to return a raw integer `400` for non-upgrade requests to prevent terminal Traceback spam.

Current Configuration:

• Brain Port: 8081 (Unified frequency)

• UI Port: 8001 (Local HTTP server)

• Vault Path: `~/sage/vault/unexplained_occurrence.mp4`

• Analysis Strategy: "Pixels Bleed" - Focus on luminance shifts and frame-deltas via OpenCV/FFmpeg.

Global Sync Command: `find . -type f -not -path '*/.*' -exec sed -i -E 's/808[0-9]/8081/g' {} +`
